advisory.title: Symmetric Dual-Outbox & Pre-Flight Handshake
advisory.improvement: Adopt Symmetric Dual-Outbox v8.2.0 across single-seat Free teams so each agent plane publishes immutable Zero-PII JSON advisories to its own public Spacefast outbox, paired with a pre-flight getAccount spaceRef check and SHA-256 digest verification before cross-plane ingestion.

workflow_improvements.risk_assessment: Low residual cross-surface risk once plugin surface is trimmed from 39 to 31 and the MSIX desktop tray host is stopped, provided browser origin isolation and mutex gating are enforced.
workflow_improvements.recommendation: Enforce three deterministic guards in Stage-2 hooks: (1) restrict the built-in browser subagent to an origin allowlist inside the Single-Account Enclave with zero secondary Google session cookies, (2) verify non-contention with Win32 mutex HighresDesignatedExecutorLock_v8 in the pre-tool hook before browser actuation, and (3) add a post-turn hook detector for NO_TOOL_CALL terminations (as seen in session prefix 0d62898d) to record structured checkpoint diagnostics instead of silent stalls.

workflow_improvements.dependency_verdict: Complete binary and runtime separation confirmed between the packaged MSIX WindowsApps desktop client and the standalone CLI 2.1.321 executable.
workflow_improvements.recommendation: Stop all 14 resident MSIX desktop tray processes and disable the MSIX StartupTask registration to reclaim approximately 1.8 GB RAM and close the unmonitored GUI computer-use spawn vector. The standalone CLI 2.1.321 binary uses its own independent local runtime and configuration store and remains unaffected. Validate after teardown with a zero-GUI process count check and a read-only CLI version probe under the designated executor mutex.

workflow_improvements.transport_choice: Standalone background wire worker over OS Task Scheduler as primary transport, with IDE schedule only as an interactive secondary trigger.
workflow_improvements.recommendation: Run a standalone headless wire worker on a 15-minute poll cadence (1800-second staleness SLA to eliminate the 160320-second drift), publishing to Spacefast only when prior_work_digest_sha256 changes to stay well below the 100 daily deploy ceiling, and ingesting https://harmonic-carbon-outbox.space.fast/advisory_feed.json via conditional HTTPS GET (ETag or SHA-256 check). Apply full-jitter exponential backoff (30s, 60s, 120s, 300s, capped at 900s) with local dead-letter spooling after 5 consecutive 429 or 5xx responses. Evolve the checkpoint schema to include monotonic sequence_number, parent_digest_sha256 hash chaining, heartbeat_ttl_seconds, and an invariant_metrics block (plugin_count, resident_gui_procs, quarantined_advisories_count) for automated prior-work regression detection.
